title: 第1660章 露馅了第1659章 指点迷津
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 刚才情不自禁看这绝色女人太入神了。
郑元幻化成的金乌族老祖心里暗道不好，赶紧收回了目光。
咳咳！
“都是自家人，有什么妥不妥的，老祖我就是刚才想起了一件往事而已……”
“这凤肉吸纳九天朝阳灵气，最能调和你体内失衡的火道根基，多吃几块，能稳固你方才顿悟突破的境界。”
郑元赶紧抬手翻转架在金乌神火上的凤肉，滋滋油滴坠入火堆，升腾起一缕诱人浓香。
面上依旧是先祖温和从容的模样，心底却暗自松了口气。
刚才失神攥住了她的手，还好借烤肉由头岔开，没彻底露了破绽。
如今只好用走神了再搪塞一下了。
金素梅捧着小块凤肉，闻言心头暖意翻涌，垂眸轻声道谢。
“老祖竟特意为弟子烤制这般珍稀灵食，弟子实在受之有愧。”
本以为先祖指点修行，为她护道已是天大恩情，万万没料到老祖还记挂着她肉身亏虚，特意备下凤肉进补，先前心底那点转瞬即逝的异样猜疑，此刻消散得干干净净，只剩满心敬重与仰慕之意。
郑元淡笑摆手，指尖一挥，又切下一大块油脂丰腴的凤肉递到她手中。
“你是金乌族百年难遇的纯血苗子，能勘破修行歧路，悟出真火调和之道，乃是我族幸事，些许凤肉算不得什么。”
“老祖过誉了，弟子哪里有那么优秀。”
金素梅听到这夸赞俏脸又是一红，心里美滋滋的。
这可是老祖的认可，要是被族中其他人知道，指不定要多羡慕自己呢。
有机会单独聆听老祖教诲，传授解惑，护自己道基，还亲手烤珍贵无比的凤肉。
说话间，金素梅小口咀嚼着凤肉，体内躁动过的火元愈发安稳柔和。
丹田内阴阳道力交织缠绕，隐隐有朝着更深一层境界沉淀的趋势。
就在下一刻忽然抬眼看向郑元幻化成的老祖，眼底带着几分怯生生的好奇。
“老祖，弟子方才顿悟之时，分明感知到您布下的金炎结界隔绝外界纷扰，足足守了弟子数个时辰，真神境界的光阴何等珍贵，弟子实在有愧……”
话未说完，郑元便轻抬指尖止住她的话头，金乌灵火在他掌心跳动，柔光落在女子泛红的脸颊上。
“修行路上，机缘稍纵即逝，本座身为金乌老祖，护持族中奇才本就是分内之事，不必挂怀。”
目光掠过少女沾了少许油光的樱唇，心底又泛起一丝不易察觉的涟漪，连忙转头去打理架上的烤肉，刻意转移话题。
“快些食用，凤肉凉了，至阳精气便会流失大半，耽误你稳固修为。”
“老祖人太好了……
金素梅乖乖点头，心头涌过一丝热流。
小口小口吃着灵肉，周身萦绕淡淡金辉，整个人的气质比之前通透温润了数倍。
渊底浮动的太阳道韵仍丝丝缕缕往她体内钻，配合凤肉的本源精气，将往日被真火灼烧留下的经脉淤堵一点点消融殆尽。
“这也太神奇了！”
金素梅那也是半神强者，老祖的烤肉里恐怕还添加了别的天材地宝等。
这份厚爱让金素梅心里又是感动不已。
就在下一刻，一道吱吱吱声从林间传了过来。
“原来是这只泼猴……”
郑元一眼就认出了，这不是那只戏耍自己的那只火灵猴嘛，刚要一伸手时，突然一愣。
那就是金素梅亲昵的拍着那只火灵猴的猴头。
“小金，这是我族老祖，快来拜见老祖……”
吱吱吱！
content_en:
Just now I couldn't help but look at this stunning woman so fascinated.
The ancestor of the Golden Crow tribe transformed into Zheng Yuan secretly thought something bad and quickly withdrew his gaze.
Ahem!
"They are all members of our own family. Is there anything wrong? Ancestor, I just remembered a past incident..."
"This phoenix meat absorbs the spiritual energy of the Nine Heavens Chaoyang, which can best reconcile the imbalanced fire path foundation in your body. Eat a few more pieces to stabilize the realm of your sudden enlightenment and breakthrough."
Zheng Yuan quickly raised his hand and turned over the phoenix meat placed on the Golden Crow Divine Fire. The sizzling oil dropped into the fire, and an alluring aroma rose.
On the face, he still had the gentle and calm look of his ancestors, but he was secretly relieved in his heart.
She had grasped her hand in a daze just now, but fortunately, she used the barbecue to move it away from her head, so that the flaw was not completely exposed.
Now I have to excuse myself by saying that I am distracted.
Jin Sumei held a small piece of phoenix meat, her heart felt warm when she heard this, she lowered her eyes and thanked her softly.
"The ancestor went out of his way to bake such rare spiritual food for his disciples. I really deserve it."
I thought it was a great kindness from my ancestor to guide her practice and protect her. I never expected that my ancestor was still worried about her physical weakness and specially prepared phoenix meat to supplement her. The fleeting suspicion in her heart had completely dissipated at this moment, leaving only the respect and admiration in her heart.
Zheng Yuan smiled lightly and waved his hand. With a wave of his fingertips, he cut off another large piece of fat and plump phoenix meat and handed it to her hand.
"You are a pure-blooded seedling that is rare to see in the Golden Crow clan in a century. It is our clan's blessing to be able to discover the wrong path in cultivation and realize the way of blending with true fire. A little phoenix meat is nothing."
"The ancestor is too praised. How can the disciple be so good?"
Jin Sumei's pretty face turned red when she heard the compliment, and she felt very happy.
This is the ancestor's approval. If other people in the clan knew about it, they might be more envious of themselves.
I had the opportunity to listen to the ancestor’s teachings alone, teach and resolve doubts, protect my Taoist foundation, and even roast the precious phoenix meat with my own hands.
While talking, Jin Sumei chewed the phoenix meat in small mouths, and the restless fire element in her body became more stable and gentle.
The yin and yang Tao forces in Dantian are intertwined and entwined, and there is a faint tendency to settle towards a deeper state.
At the next moment, he suddenly raised his eyes to look at Zheng Yuan's transformed ancestor, with a bit of timid curiosity in his eyes.
"Old Ancestor, when this disciple just realized his enlightenment, he clearly sensed that the golden flame barrier you set up blocked the outside world and guarded the disciple for several hours. The time in the true god realm is so precious, and the disciple is really ashamed..."
Before she finished speaking, Zheng Yuan gently raised his fingertips to stop her words. The golden crow spirit fire danced in his palm, and the soft light fell on the woman's red cheeks.
"On the road to cultivation, opportunities are fleeting. As the ancestor of the Golden Crow, it is my duty to protect the geniuses in the clan, so there is no need to worry about it."
His eyes passed over the girl's slightly oily cherry lips, and there was an imperceptible ripple in his heart. He quickly turned his head to take care of the barbecue on the shelf, deliberately changing the subject.
"Eat it quickly. When the phoenix meat is cold, most of the Yang essence will be lost, which will delay your ability to stabilize your cultivation."
"The ancestors are so kind...
Jin Sumei nodded obediently, feeling a surge of heat in her heart.
As he ate the spiritual meat in small bites, a faint golden glow lingered around his body, and his whole temperament was several times clearer and warmer than before.
The Tao Yun of the Sun floating at the bottom of the abyss still penetrated into her body, and combined with the original essence of the phoenix flesh, the blockage in the meridians left by the real fire in the past was dissolved bit by bit.
"This is amazing! "
Jin Sumei is also a powerful demigod, and the ancestor's barbecue may have included other heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
This love made Jin Sumei deeply moved.
The next moment, a creaking sound came from the forest.
"It turns out to be this monkey..."
Zheng Yuan recognized it at a glance. This was not the fire monkey that was playing tricks on him. Just when he was about to reach out his hand, he was suddenly startled.
That was Jin Sumei patting the fire monkey's head affectionately.
"Xiao Jin, this is the ancestor of our clan, come and pay homage to the ancestor..."
Squeak!
